title: Tiny Wins
description:
Web app for tracking your habits and wins, no matter how small.

Track your wins, make a habit out of them and get inspired by other users and their wins.
why: Mainly my own need: tracking small wins kept me motivated in 2020. It was also a chance to try Recoil and Laravel Sanctum SPA authentication, and to build a small community product.
learned: Distribution beats code. Building it was the easy(ish) part. Social features need a critical mass of users, and getting people in was the real work which I wasn't prepared for.
